## [1.4.0] - 2026-11-13

### ⚠ BREAKING CHANGES

- **api:** The orders endpoint now returns prices in cents instead of the previous unit. Update any clients that read price fields. (#214)

### Added

- **cart:** Carts are now saved for logged-out users for 30 days. (#211)
- **ui:** Dark mode for the account page. (#217)

### Fixed

- **checkout:** The total now applies the discount code on mobile. (#213)
- **search:** The search box no longer loses focus after the first letter is typed. (#215)
- **auth:** Password reset links now expire as intended. (#219)

## [2.0.0] - 2026-11-20

### ⚠ BREAKING CHANGES
- Removed the deprecated `/v1/customers` endpoint. Clients still calling it must migrate to its replacement before upgrading. ([#305])

### Added
- Download invoices as PDF. ([#301])
- Invite teammates by email. ([#304])

### Changed
- Search results load about twice as fast on large catalogues. ([#308])

### Fixed
- VAT is now rounded correctly for totals ending in .5. ([#303])
- The date picker no longer shows the wrong month in Safari. ([#307])

### Security
- Fixed an issue where uploaded files could be read by other accounts. ([#309])

## [0.9.2] - 2026-12-01

### ⚠ BREAKING CHANGES
- **cli:** The config file has been renamed from `.toolrc` to `tool.toml`. Rename your existing config file to keep your settings. (#41)

### Security
- **deps:** Upgraded the YAML parser to patch a remote code execution vulnerability (CVE-2026-4411). (#44)

### Added
- New `tool doctor` command that checks your setup. (#42)

### Fixed
- **cli:** The `--quiet` flag no longer prints warnings. (#40)
- Fixed a crash on Windows paths that contain spaces. (#45)

## [3.2.0] - 2026-12-08

### ⚠ Breaking Changes
- **api:** The trips endpoint now paginates by default, returning 50 trips per page. (#518)

### Added
- **maps:** Offline maps for saved trips. (#515)
- **share:** Share a trip with a link that expires. (#519)

### Removed
- Removed the legacy trip importer. (#524)

### Fixed
- **sync:** Edits made offline were lost after login. (#517)
- **ui:** Map pins overlapped on small screens. (#521)

### Security
- **share:** Shared links exposed the owner's email address. (#522)

## [1.11.0] - 2027-01-05

### ⚠ Breaking Changes
- Dropped support for Internet Explorer 11 (#93)

### Added
- Spell check in the editor for 14 languages (#87)
- Export documents as Markdown (#91)
- arm64 builds (#88)

### Fixed
- Security: session tokens were written to the browser console (#90)
- Undo in the editor skipped every second change (#89)
- Tables pasted from Excel lost their borders (#94)

## [4.0.1] - 2027-01-19

### ⚠ Breaking Changes
- **billing:** Annual plans now renew on the purchase date instead of the 1st of the month. (#702)

### Added
- **billing:** Subscriptions can now be paused for up to 3 months. (#706)

### Security
- **webhooks:** Webhook signatures are now verified, so forged webhooks are rejected. (#705)

### Fixed
- **emails:** Receipts showed the wrong currency symbol. (#703)
- CSV export cut off rows after 10,000. (#707)

## [1.4.0] - 2026-11-13

### ⚠ BREAKING CHANGES

- **api:** The orders endpoint now returns prices in cents. Update any clients that expect the previous price format. (#214)

### Added

- **cart:** Carts are now saved for logged-out users for 30 days. (#211)
- **ui:** The account page now has a dark mode. (#217)

### Fixed

- **checkout:** The order total now applies the discount code on mobile. (#213)
- **search:** The search box no longer loses focus after the first letter is typed. (#215)

### Security

- **auth:** Password reset links now expire. Before this fix, they stayed valid indefinitely. (#219)

## [2.0.0] - 2026-11-20

### ⚠ BREAKING CHANGES

- **api:** Removed the deprecated `/v1/customers` endpoint. (#305)

### Added

- **export:** Invoices can now be downloaded as PDF. (#301)
- Teammates can now be invited by email. (#304)

### Changed

- **search:** Results load twice as fast on large catalogues. (#308)

### Fixed

- **upload:** Fixed a security issue where uploaded files could be read by other accounts. (#309)
- **invoices:** Fixed VAT rounding in the wrong direction for totals ending in .5. (#303)
- **ui:** Fixed the date picker showing the wrong month in Safari. (#307)

## [0.9.2] - 2026-12-01

## [3.2.0] - 2026-12-08

### ⚠ Breaking Changes
- **api:** The trips endpoint now paginates by default, returning 50 trips per page. Clients that expect the full list in one response must request further pages. (#518)
- **import:** The legacy trip importer has been removed. (#524)

### Added
- **maps:** Saved trips are now available as offline maps. (#515)
- **share:** You can share a trip with a link that expires. (#519)

### Fixed
- **sync:** Edits made offline are no longer lost after login. (#517)
- **ui:** Map pins no longer overlap on small screens. (#521)

### Security
- **share:** Shared links no longer expose the owner's email address. (#522)

## 1.11.0 - 2027-01-05

### ⚠ Breaking Changes
- Dropped support for Internet Explorer 11. (#93)

### Added
- **editor:** Spell check for 14 languages. (#87)
- **export:** Export documents as Markdown. (#91)

### Fixed
- **auth:** Session tokens were written to the browser console. They are no longer logged. (#90)
- **editor:** Undo skipped every second change. (#89)
- Tables pasted from Excel lost their borders. (#94)

### Build
- Produce arm64 builds. (#88)
